name: Empty Earwig 5
author: roufkp
description: Outlined rounded blue button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(5px), box-shadow becomes inset 1px -11px 25px 10px #5b58f0.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Empty Earwig 5</title>
<style>
/* Empty Earwig 5 by roufkp — https://uiverse.io/roufkp/empty-earwig-5 */
.button {
  width: fit-content;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  border: none;
  box-shadow: inset 0px 22px 20px 10px rgb(0, 0, 0);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: antiquewhite;
  letter-spacing: .1rem;
  transition: all 0.51s ease-in-out;
}

.button:hover {
  transform: translateY(5px);
  box-shadow: inset 1px -11px 25px 10px rgb(91, 88, 240);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
